failed_markers.reason: A real AnchorBank generation array overwrote scalar metadata; gated runs errored when older group anchors were first scored. All raw artifacts retained. New regression test exercises the live bank-to-gate path. A separate reward-feature coverage issue is also being investigated.

failed_markers.name: write_stream_known_pilot

failed_markers.name: write_stream_known_pilot_v2
failed_markers.reason: Float32 policy probabilities were cast to float64 without renormalization; numpy choice rejected their tiny sum error. No protocol claim is based on this failed run.

failed_markers.name: write_stream_known_pilot_v3
failed_markers.reason: Stopped to repair repeated full-window history recomputation. Known-route trial was unnecessarily O(window) several times per step. Raw CSV tail may have been buffered when the process stopped.

source_audit.interpretation: Numerical comparisons use identical executable code and configurations; the strict whole-source equality audit is not a clean pass. This documentary variation is disclosed, not hidden or repaired in place.
source_audit.issue: One worker snapshotted a post-selection causal-control documentation addendum while the other 14 snapshotted the unchanged frozen main protocol. The addendum was subsequently moved to docs/WRITE_CONTROL_SUPPLEMENT.md.

limitations: 正式 cohort 的 PROVENANCE_NOTE 记录了 docs-only hash 变异：代码和配置相同，但 strict source audit 不是 clean pass。
cold_prior_binding 未经过 gate；stream 观测到的绑定结果不能解释为已验证安全写入。
当前任务环境是自定义 9×9 navigation 与 detour，不是 SOTA 结果，也不能外推为通用导航能力。
正式结果最多 3 个 seed，只作描述性统计，不作显著性声称；episodes 和 transitions 不作为独立样本。
报告保留失败和负结果；不会自动给出‘创新已证明’结论。
报告只统计 summary/failed marker 明示的实验成本；本报告自身的合成单元测试不计入样本效率。
CPU 时间是各 run CPU 秒求和；wall 时间是各 run wall duration 求和，不代表 cohort 端到端 makespan。
Checkpoint、W0 与 actor 字节优先取物理文件长度；缺少可核对文件时会标记 capacity.json 回退来源，不把声明值伪装成实测。
